rationale: All 3 lenses ran with parseable output. 4/4 applicable spec criteria pass (3 correctly marked na — backend concerns outside this diff's scope). 1 real finding from the blind lens (tooltip grammar breaks with 2+ simultaneous blockers) was fixed inline with 2 new regression tests, both verified RED before the fix and GREEN after. 8 further observations across blind+edge-case were triaged: 2 were false positives disproven by reading the actual file (calculateTotalAssignments is not dead code — still used at line 646 for the confirmation-modal warning; the test's NavigationMore mock's disabled/tooltip props match the real menuItems.push shape and the established mock pattern from editFlow.test.tsx; no i18n tooling exists anywhere in this file or repo for these strings, so the i18n-bypass concern does not apply). The remaining 6 (undefined/NaN/negative counter values, counters:null vs undefined divergence, the generic-sum-to-explicit-allowlist policy shift, and the confirmation-modal still warning on integrations-only projects) are all either pre-existing patterns unchanged by this diff (verified via the diff hunks — hasCountData and calculateTotalAssignments's summation are untouched) or intentional/accurate behavior already validated by the acceptance lens (the modal warning is truthful: integrations are still auto-deleted as a side effect). None are blocking. 0 findings meet the patch/decision_needed bar after the grammar fix landed.
